note: Piatt County zoning is published only as a subscription download ($40/yr via CCGISC/county license agreement) and a view-only County Zoning layer in the county webmap (maps.piattcounty.org). No public ArcGIS REST, WFS or file service of zoning districts was found. Its webmap/mobile app did not expose a service URL. The parcel layer on ArcGIS Online (IL_Piatt_County_Parcels, services9.arcgis.com) has an empty ZONING field. Monticello city zoning map is not queryable either.
